SELECT customer_id, customer_name
FROM customers
WHERE is_active = TRUE
  AND region = 'North';

SELECT order_id
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'completed'
  AND ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01 00:00:00';

SELECT c.region, COUNT(o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'completed') AS completed_order_count
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.region

SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - o.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS net_value
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.category

SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS completed_home_order_count
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND p.category = 'home'
GROUP BY o.customer_id

SELECT c.region, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(o.completed_order_count, 0)::numeric), 2) AS average_completed_order_count
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS completed_order_count
    FROM orders
    WHERE status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY customer_id
) AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.region

SELECT o.customer_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - o.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS net_value
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY o.customer_id
ORDER BY net_value DESC, o.customer_id
LIMIT 3

SELECT event_id, vehicle_id
FROM telemetry_events
WHERE (payload #>> '{engine,temperature_c}')::NUMERIC >= 100

SELECT v.depot_id, ROUND(AVG(f.liters * f.price_per_liter), 2) AS average_cost
FROM fuel_events AS f
JOIN vehicles AS v ON v.vehicle_id = f.vehicle_id
GROUP BY v.depot_id

SELECT route_id, ROUND(AVG(distance_km / NULLIF(fuel_liters, 0)), 2) AS kilometres_per_litre
FROM trips
GROUP BY route_id

SELECT v.vehicle_id, COUNT(m.maintenance_id) AS maintenance_event_count
FROM vehicles AS v
LEFT JOIN maintenance_events AS m
  ON m.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id
 AND m.performed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-29 12:00:00'
 AND m.performed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-30 12:00:00'
GROUP BY v.vehicle_id

SELECT t.driver_id, COUNT(*) AS cargo_trip_count
FROM trips AS t
JOIN vehicles AS v ON v.vehicle_id = t.vehicle_id
WHERE v.vehicle_class = 'cargo'
GROUP BY t.driver_id

SELECT v.vehicle_id, t.event_at AS latest_event_timestamp, (t.payload #>> '{engine,temperature_c}')::NUMERIC AS engine_temperature FROM vehicles AS v JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (vehicle_id) vehicle_id, event_at, payload FROM telemetry_events ORDER BY vehicle_id, event_at DESC, event_id DESC) AS t ON t.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id ORDER BY v.vehicle_id

SELECT r.route_id, ROUND(AVG(t.distance_km / NULLIF(t.fuel_liters, 0)), 2) AS rounded_efficiency
FROM trips AS t
JOIN routes AS r ON r.route_id = t.route_id
GROUP BY r.route_id
ORDER BY rounded_efficiency DESC, r.route_id
LIMIT 3

SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(st.ticket_id) FILTER (WHERE st.priority = 'urgent') AS urgent_ticket_count
FROM accounts AS a
LEFT JOIN support_tickets AS st ON st.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY a.account_id

SELECT t.ticket_id
FROM support_tickets AS t
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT s.plan_id
  FROM subscriptions AS s
  WHERE s.account_id = t.account_id
  ORDER BY s.starts_on DESC, s.subscription_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS latest_subscription ON TRUE
JOIN service_plans AS p ON p.plan_id = latest_subscription.plan_id
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM ticket_events AS e
  WHERE e.ticket_id = t.ticket_id
    AND e.event_type = 'agent_response'
    AND e.event_at > t.opened_at + p.first_response_sla_hours * INTERVAL '1 hour'
    AND e.event_at > t.opened_at
);

SELECT account_id, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'urgent')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS urgent_ticket_share
FROM support_tickets
GROUP BY account_id

SELECT account_id, ticket_count
FROM (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count
  FROM support_tickets
  GROUP BY account_id
) AS account_ticket_counts
WHERE ticket_count > (SELECT AVG(ticket_count) FROM (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count FROM support_tickets GROUP BY account_id) AS average_counts)

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM accounts AS a
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM support_tickets AS t
    WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id
      AND t.status IN ('open', 'pending')
)
OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM incidents AS i
    WHERE i.account_id = a.account_id
      AND i.severity = 'high'
);

SELECT account_id, SUM(total_due) AS total_paid_invoice_amount
FROM invoices
WHERE status = 'paid'
GROUP BY account_id

SELECT account_id, plan_id
FROM (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        plan_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY account_id
            ORDER BY starts_on DESC, subscription_id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM subscriptions
) AS ranked
WHERE rn = 1;

SELECT s.account_id, SUM(p.monthly_price) AS monthly_recurring_revenue
FROM subscriptions AS s
JOIN plans AS p ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id
WHERE s.status = 'active'
GROUP BY s.account_id

SELECT account_id
FROM usage_events
WHERE occurred_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND occurred_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING SUM(units) > 1000;

SELECT invoice_id
FROM invoices
WHERE status = 'open'
  AND due_on < DATE '2026-06-30';

SELECT DISTINCT s.plan_id
FROM subscriptions AS s
WHERE s.status = 'active'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM entitlements AS e
    WHERE e.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
      AND e.enabled = TRUE
  );

SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS usage_event_count
FROM usage_events
WHERE (payload #>> '{units}')::INTEGER >= 1000
GROUP BY account_id

SELECT warehouse_id, product_id
FROM (
    SELECT warehouse_id, product_id, on_hand_qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY warehouse_id, product_id
               ORDER BY snapshot_at DESC, snapshot_id DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM inventory_snapshots
) AS latest
WHERE rn = 1
  AND on_hand_qty >= 20;

SELECT w.warehouse_id, SUM(si.quantity) AS total_shipped_quantity
FROM warehouses AS w
JOIN shipments AS s ON s.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
JOIN shipment_items AS si ON si.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
GROUP BY w.warehouse_id

SELECT po.warehouse_id, SUM(pol.ordered_qty) AS received_quantity
FROM purchase_orders AS po
JOIN purchase_order_lines AS pol ON pol.po_id = po.po_id
WHERE po.status = 'open'
GROUP BY po.warehouse_id

SELECT warehouse_id, product_id, on_hand_qty AS quantity
FROM (
    SELECT warehouse_id,
           product_id,
           on_hand_qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY warehouse_id, product_id
               ORDER BY snapshot_at DESC, snapshot_id DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM inventory_snapshots
) AS latest
WHERE rn = 1

SELECT DISTINCT s.shipment_id
FROM shipments AS s
JOIN delivery_events AS de
  ON de.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
WHERE de.event_type = 'delivered'
  AND de.event_at > s.promised_at;

SELECT s.warehouse_id, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.picked_at - s.shipped_at)) / 3600.0) AS average_hours FROM shipments AS s JOIN shipment_items AS si ON si.shipment_id = s.shipment_id JOIN pick_events AS p ON p.shipment_item_id = si.shipment_item_id WHERE s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND p.picked_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.warehouse_id

SELECT pol.product_id, SUM(pol.ordered_qty) - COALESCE(SUM(r.received_qty), 0) AS quantity_ordered_not_yet_received
FROM purchase_order_lines AS pol
LEFT JOIN receipts AS r ON r.po_line_id = pol.po_line_id
GROUP BY pol.product_id
HAVING COUNT(pol.po_line_id) > 0

SELECT delivery_id
FROM delivery_events
WHERE (payload #>> '{temperature_c}')::NUMERIC >= 7

SELECT si.product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT si.shipment_id) AS shipment_count
FROM shipment_items AS si
GROUP BY si.product_id

SELECT w.warehouse_id
FROM warehouses AS w
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM inventory_snapshots AS i
    WHERE i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
      AND i.on_hand_qty = 0
);

WITH shipped AS (SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS shipped_qty FROM shipments JOIN shipment_items USING (shipment_id) GROUP BY warehouse_id), received AS (SELECT purchase_orders.warehouse_id, SUM(receipts.received_qty) AS received_qty FROM purchase_orders JOIN purchase_order_lines USING (po_id) JOIN receipts USING (po_line_id) GROUP BY purchase_orders.warehouse_id) SELECT w.warehouse_id, COALESCE(shipped.shipped_qty, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(COALESCE(received.received_qty, 0), 0) AS shipped_to_received_ratio FROM warehouses AS w LEFT JOIN shipped ON shipped.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN received ON received.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
SELECT alert_id FROM alerts WHERE status = 'open';

SELECT t.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM transactions AS t
WHERE (t.payload #>> '{risk_score}')::NUMERIC >= 70
GROUP BY t.account_id

SELECT a.severity, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.investigation_id IS NOT NULL)::numeric / COUNT(*) AS investigation_fraction
FROM alerts AS a
LEFT JOIN investigations AS i ON i.alert_id = a.alert_id
GROUP BY a.severity
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

SELECT le.device_id
FROM login_events AS le
JOIN accounts AS a ON a.account_id = le.account_id
WHERE le.result = 'success'
GROUP BY le.device_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 1

SELECT transaction_id
FROM transactions
WHERE (payload #>> '{risk_score}')::NUMERIC >= 80

SELECT customer_id, risk_score
FROM (
    SELECT customer_id, risk_score,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY customer_id
               ORDER BY assessed_at DESC, assessment_id DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM risk_assessments
) AS latest
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY risk_score DESC, customer_id
LIMIT 3

SELECT DISTINCT a.customer_id
FROM alerts AS a
WHERE a.status = 'open'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM watchlist_matches AS wm
    WHERE wm.customer_id = a.customer_id
      AND wm.cleared_at IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT c.customer_id
FROM customers AS c
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM alerts AS a
    WHERE a.customer_id = c.customer_id
      AND a.status = 'open'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM investigations AS i
    JOIN alerts AS a2 ON a2.alert_id = i.alert_id
    WHERE a2.customer_id = c.customer_id
      AND i.closed_at IS NULL
);

SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(wm.match_id) FILTER (WHERE wm.cleared_at IS NULL) AS unresolved_watchlist_matches
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN watchlist_matches AS wm ON wm.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id

SELECT c.segment, ROUND(AVG(t.amount), 2) AS average_amount
FROM transactions AS t
JOIN accounts AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
GROUP BY c.segment

SELECT DISTINCT s.shipment_id
FROM shipments AS s
JOIN delivery_events AS d ON d.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
WHERE d.event_type = 'delivered'
  AND d.event_at > s.promised_at;
